title: Application Load Balancer to Amazon API Gateway Private Rest API
description: Cross Account Private API Access via Public Application Load Balancer.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This sample pattern allows users from one account to access their Private REST APIs present in another account over the internet.

This facilitates abstraction of network resources (like load balancers, virtual private clouds, endpoints) & application resources (like lambda, api gateway) into separate individual management accounts.
